role_voices.text_zh: 剛炸好的雞翅，要來點嗎？
role_voices.text_en: I just finished frying some chicken, want to try some?

role_voices.text_zh: 你有需要裝備的話，隨時找我幫忙！
role_voices.text_en: If you need any equipment, just give me a shout!

role_voices.text_zh: 要隨時記得保養武器，它才不會背叛你。
role_voices.text_en: If you remember to maintain your weapon, it will never let you down.

role_voices.text_zh: 你的武器，我來幫你保養吧？
role_voices.text_en: I can help you maintain your weapon.

role_voices.text_zh: 哈啊……總覺得這裡實在有點熱，要不再脫一件？
role_voices.text_en: Hah... I think it feels a little stuffy in here, maybe I should take off another layer?

role_voices.text_zh: 下次陪我一起去健身吧，不然腰部很痠的♥
role_voices.text_en: You should accompany me on my next workout, otherwise you might throw out my hips♥

role_voices.text_zh: 哈啊……啤酒不小心喝多了♥♥
role_voices.text_en: Hah... I think I had a little too much beer♥♥

role_voices.text_zh: 再這麼慢吞吞的，那就換我吃了你喔♥
role_voices.text_en: If you don't hurry up, it will be my turn to eat you♥
